title: Dragon's Back Race official home page — 2027 entries open, Full Dragon and shorter formats
claims: Entries for the 2027 Dragon's Back Race are open on the official site.
The Full Dragon covers 380 km with 16,400 m of ascent along the Dragon's Back of Wales.
The event is described as a legendary 380 km, 6-day ultra running journey through Wales.
Shorter formats run alongside the main event: Dragon's Fire (two-day northern sections), Dragon's Tail (two-day southern sections) and the flexible Hatchling.
